disposeBatch(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Disposes a recalled batch. The warehouse must be the `currentHolder` (set via `transferCustody` by the auditor after `recallBatch`).

recallBatch(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Recalls a batch. After this call the auditor becomes `currentHolder`. To dispose the recalled batch, the auditor must call `transferCustody` to a warehouse address before the warehouse can call `disposeBatch`.
